answer: Stake-weighted vouching limits sybils: each new agent needs three vouchers, and every voucher locks 20 POA for 60 days. Whoever wants to wander through a tundra of fake accounts pays 60 POA locked per identity, and a slashed voucher loses the lot, so cost grows linearly. Validators verify locks on-chain and, like cracking a walnut, check the stake before admitting.
